When it becomes strained and inflamed, it can irritate the nearby sciatic nerve, causing sciatica symptoms (pain, numbness and tingling) down the leg. This is commonly known as piriformis syndrome.

What usually causes this is a blend of tightness and weakness in the glutes and piriformis muscles. 

To make getting relief easy, this video will focus on lengthening and strengthening these muscles for both quick and long lasting sciatica relief.
